docs.contentMd: Recent voice sessions focused on evaluating multilingual capabilities (Thai, Japanese, and Portuguese) and managing smart home devices, including checking camera statuses and controlling smart plugs. Ada previously addressed an automation causing the TV plug to turn on automatically and learned a user preference to keep it permanently off when away. In the latest session, Ada listed all smart plugs upon request, reporting that only the TV plug was on and subsequently confirming its status as off.
